subject: Web Development
subcategory: Famous Websites That Changed the World
title: Notion: The All-in-One Workspace
description: A quick win: understand Notion: The All-in-One Workspace.

hook.text: Teams juggled separate apps for docs, wikis, tasks, and databases. Notion combined them.

buildup.text: Everything is a block — text, tables, Kanban boards, and embeds — all on one flexible page.

discovery.text: Templates let teams spin up project trackers, meeting notes, and wikis in seconds.

twist.text: Notion nearly died in 2016 when it ran out of funding. The founders rebuilt it from scratch in Japan.

climax.text: Notion showed that a single web app could replace an entire suite of productivity tools.

punchline.text: One app replaced a dozen tools for millions.
